name: Preserving Eldarath
summary: Commander Truesong asks you to recover relics from Eldarath and drive out the Spitelash. The ruins hold Kaldorei history that she believes is worth preserving.

sections.title: A Ruin Worth Saving
sections.body: The Kaldorei once made Eldarath a place of glory and might. Commander Truesong asks you to help preserve what remains of that history. The Spitelash are ransacking the ruins, and she wants them driven out before more is lost.

sections.title: Truesong's Resolve
sections.body: Truesong believes Eldarath's history is worth fighting for, though some Kaldorei would leave the ruins to the naga. You bring back relics and the head of Lord Sarthiss, but Truesong says the work there continues. The fight to preserve Eldarath remains unfinished.

faq.answer: Eldarath was once a place of Kaldorei glory and might. Commander Truesong believes its remaining relics are worth saving.
The Spitelash are ransacking Eldarath, and Commander Truesong wants them driven out.
Commander Truesong asks you to recover relics from Eldarath and believes the Kaldorei history there is worth fighting for.

faq.q: What does Truesong ask you to recover?
faq.answer: Truesong asks you to bring back Eldarath relics and Lord Sarthiss' head.
Eldarath is in Azshara. The road north east leads into the heart of the ruins.

faq.q: Is the work in Eldarath finished?
faq.answer: No. Truesong says the work in Eldarath is far from over and that the effort must continue.
